description: Election Commission - Mr. Ameen Farees of the Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns a local government electoral matter, specifically the declaration that a member of the Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party (Sri Lanka Muslim Congress). This falls under election-related processes as defined by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
